package main

import (
	"flag"
	"time"
)

var verbose = flag.Bool("verbose", false, "verbose output")

func main() {
	var port int
	flag.IntVar(&port, "port", 8080, "listen port")
	name := flag.String("name", "", "name")
	flag.Duration("timeout", time.Second, "timeout")
	flag.Func("define", "define a thing", func(string) error { return nil })
	flag.Var(nil, "level", "log level")
	flag.CommandLine.Bool("cl-bool", false, "through CommandLine")
	flag.Parse()
	_, _ = name, verbose
}
